title: South Korea's Growing Interests in Mercosur and Brazil
description: South Korea is reportedly advancing in trade negotiations with Mercosur and seeking alliances in artificial intelligence and rare earths with Brazil.

sections.heading: Trade Negotiations
paragraphs: According to LaRepublica.co, Brazil and South Korea are making progress in negotiations for a trade agreement with Mercosur.

sections.heading: Military Cooperation
paragraphs: Agencia de Noticias Yonhap reports that Lee inspected a C-390 military transport aircraft.

sections.heading: Technological and Resource Alliances
paragraphs: Infodefensa mentions that South Korea is looking for alliances in artificial intelligence and rare earths with Brazil.

faq.q: What are Brazil and South Korea negotiating?
faq.a: Brazil and South Korea are advancing in negotiations for a trade agreement with Mercosur, as reported by LaRepublica.co.

faq.q: Why is South Korea interested in Brazil?
faq.a: South Korea is seeking alliances in artificial intelligence and rare earths with Brazil, as stated by Infodefensa.
